responsibility: Defines the public method-lookup interface for `check`, including method-call and UFCS resolution entry points, the `MethodCallee` and method error types, and shared helpers that connect probing, confirmation, candidate reporting, and stability tracking.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is narrowly dedicated to method and UFCS lookup within type checking, defining method-resolution result/error types and lookup entry points instead of general check-phase or crate-wide query coordination.
